editorial_principles.principle: Lead with one unifying capability before mechanism obligations
editorial_principles.revtrace_action: Unify EL/AU/SUP, accepted results and supported failure paths under preservation of valid progress with the original selection task
editorial_principles.limitation: ReCraft actually has two protocol contribution families; one unifying capability is an editorial recommendation, not a universal observed feature count

editorial_principles.principle: Introduce logical actors and objects before implementation plumbing
editorial_principles.revtrace_action: Introduce Worker, Owner and Consumer in the explanatory narrative before EL/AU/SUP labels; keep logical roles distinct from process deployment

editorial_principles.principle: Connect each claim to a named comparison, explicit endpoint, result and mechanism explanation
editorial_principles.revtrace_action: Order result subsections by the capability tested and what the evidence establishes, retaining comparator identity and negative outcomes

editorial_principles.principle: Carry the same concrete objects through mechanism explanation
source_anchors: PRAXIS Fig.1 p3 and Fig.7 p10
editorial_principles.revtrace_action: Use one original call, parent state, complete result and actual whole view; keep confirmation distinct from endorsing successor predictions and from committing UNKNOWN inputs

editorial_principles.principle: Let a measured figure explain its event, units, comparison identity and observed consequence
editorial_principles.revtrace_action: Keep v14 Fig.1 measured and Fig.2 schematic; make legends/captions independent enough to explain the service gap without protocol lookup

no_scope_expansion: No substitution for full technical and rendered-PDF review
